en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Abu Najran, from Aaim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> regarding

a man who accepted upon himself with a Penalty (Hadd), and he did not name which Penalty (Hadd) it was. Heasws said: ‘He would be whipped until it so happens that he is the one who prevents the Penalty (Hadd) from himself’.
